findings.quote: South Korea signed a $120bn agreement last Friday to build eight large reactors in the US (Yuanta)
findings.why: The Yuanta note (titled "South Korea Plans $120bn Investment in 8 US Nuclear Plants", published 2026-09-22) says the two sides are "expected to sign" the agreement on September 18; the context never confirms a signature took place.
findings.fix: Change "signed" to "agreed to sign" or "is set to sign" so the status matches Yuanta's wording.

findings.quote: small modular reactors now carrying most of the new North American capacity in its projections
findings.why: CIBC's read of the IAEA outlook says SMRs are expected to be ~28% of new capacity through 2060 and "up to 60% in North America", an upper bound rather than a central case of a majority.
findings.fix: Rewrite as "with small modular reactors reaching as much as 60% of new North American capacity in its projections".
